Separate original T-Watch S3 tab and firmware-t-watch-s3 target, distinct from Plus.
Official supported hardware page explicitly groups T-Deck and T-Deck Plus.
README Hardware/Base explicitly links the BASIC Core IoT development kit. Core2 is only an unchecked planned target and is not linked.

Explicit K151 hardware-support library. Classified as library; product factory AI features are not presented as BSP application features.
